5 Portland Fabric and Craft Stores You Need to Visit - Portland Living on the Cheap
s: 1 month ago - For all of us who can appreciate our city’s artistic creativity, but prefer to craft from home, I’ve gathered a list of five Portland fabric and craft stores you need to visit. All of these stores offer a variety of fabrics and craft supplies at budget-friendly prices, making it possible for individuals to explore their passions without breaking the bank. The appeal of discount fabric and craft stores extends beyond the cost savings. Some of these stores host workshops, classes and events to inspire and educate their customers. Before buying online or heading to a national chain, visit one of these Portland fabric and craft stores.
